using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata;
namespace @@NAMESPACE@@;

internal static class JsonTypes
{
    internal static JsonSerializerOptions CreateOptions(JsonSerializerOptions? source = null)
    {
        if (source is null) return SchemaJsonContext.Default.Options;
        var options = new JsonSerializerOptions(source);
        // The generated resolver is deliberately exclusive: there is no reflection fallback.
        options.TypeInfoResolver = SchemaJsonContext.Default;
        options.MakeReadOnly();
        return options;
    }
    internal static JsonTypeInfo<T> Get<T>(JsonSerializerOptions options) => ReferenceEquals(options, SchemaJsonContext.Default.Options)
        ? JsonTypeCache<T>.Info : (JsonTypeInfo<T>)options.GetTypeInfo(typeof(T));

}
